**Position** 
 Overview We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Project Manager / Support Lead to manage our production support, continuous enhancement, and operational governance across the SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) landscape. This role combines hands\-on functional understanding of core BRIM pillars with project management discipline. You will lead a blended onshore/offshore team, enforce ITIL\-based SLA/KPI targets, drive critical incident resolution, and govern small\-to\-medium business enhancements from scoping to hypercare.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Support Operations \& SLA Governance Lead day\-to\-day operations for Level 2 and Level 3 production support across the entire SAP BRIM suite. Own and report operational KPIs: mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to resolve (MTTR), SLA compliance (\>98%), ticket backlog trends, and first\-time\-fix rates. Serve as the primary escalation point for Priority 1/2 billing, mediation, rating, and invoicing incidents; lead root cause analyses (RCA) and post\-mortem discussions. Manage high\-volume recurring operations: month\-end billing cycles, automated rating batches, bill\-run failures, out\-of\-sequence consumption data, and financial posting reconciliations.
 



 2\. Project Management \& Continuous Improvement Manage minor release cadences, change requests (CRs), and platform enhancements using hybrid Agile/Scrum or Waterfall frameworks. Own project schedules, resource allocations, sprint backlogs, risk/issues/assumptions/dependencies (RAID) logs, and release readiness checklists. Coordinate end\-to\-end delivery: requirement discovery, solution design review, build, system integration testing (SIT), regression testing, cutover, and post\-deployment stabilization. Interface directly with business finance, IT steering committees, external System Integrators (SIs), and vendor partners.
 



 3\. Functional Oversight \& Solution Integrity Provide functional governance across core modules: SAP SOM (Subscription Order Management): Subscription lifecycle, master agreements, product catalog, provider contracts. SAP CC (Convergent Charging): Rating and charging logic, charge plans, allowance logic, subscriber mapping. SAP CI (Convergent Invoicing): Billable items (BITs), consumption items (CITs), bill runs, aggregation, invoicing rules. SAP RAR: Revenue postings, reconciliation \& rev\-rec. Coordinate integration integrity with SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP CPQ, SAP Integration Suite (CPI), external CRM, and data mediation layers.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience Total Experience:** 




 8\+ years of IT delivery/support experience, with at least 4\+ years dedicated to SAP BRIM (formerly Hybris Billing) and 3\+ years running project management or application maintenance services (AMS).
 



 Core Technical Expertise: Functional or technical depth in at least two of the four BRIM components (SOM, CC, CI, RAR) alongside familiarity with the overall end\-to\-end data pipeline.
 



 Support Frameworks: Proven experience running structured ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management) using tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or SAP Solution Manager.
 



  





**Project Delivery:** 
 Demonstrated success managing cross\-functional technical teams (developers, functional consultants, BASIS, middleware teams) across distributed time zones. Integration Acumen: Familiarity with modern SAP interface technologies (OData, REST APIs, IDocs, SAP CPI) and reconciliation between rated events and general ledger entries.
 



  





 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related discipline.
